name: Kalameet
description: (Tag:draconic)(Tag:flying)(Tag:large-size)A descendant of the immortal Archdragons, Kalameet is the Black Dragon of Calamity that even Anor Londo dared not provoke. He has obsidian scales tougher than metal, incinerating dark-flame breath, and a glowing orange forehead crest that weakens and brings even the toughest warriors to their knees.
